successors.name: Granadine Confederation
successors.text: the infobox list of Mosquera's side: Cauca, Santander, Boyacá, Magdalena, Tolima (modern departments standing for the nineteenth-century sovereign states)

ledger.x: 8 May 1860: Mosquera declares the Sovereign State of Cauca a separate nation.
1861: Santander, Boyacá, Magdalena and Tolima stand with Mosquera.
18 July 1861: Bogotá falls and the rebels become the government.

wars.name: Colombian Civil War (1860–1862)
wars.outcome: The rebels win: Bogotá falls on 18 July 1861, Mosquera becomes provisional president, and the war ends in November 1862 when the last Conservative leaders die or give up (the page also names 8 May 1863, the Rionegro Convention, as the formal end).

certainty.note: No frontier of the rebel states is given on any page; the modern departments are an approximation of states that were themselves loosely bounded.
